title: Kanda 9: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 9.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 9.

verses.original: मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः । माध्वीर्नः सन्त्वोषधीः ॥
verses.transliteration: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||
verses.translation: Sweet blow the winds of cosmic truth; sweet flow the rivers; sweet to us be the healing herbs!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Madhu hymn: experiencing the sweet divine essence pulsating throughout the cosmos.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: Sweet blow the winds of cosmic truth; sweet flow the rivers; sweet to us be the healing herbs!
